purpose: Classifies AST-detected command-execution sites for reproducibility review; it does not promote a command to preservation evidence.

classes.repository_native_orchestration: Repository-local Python or Git workflow orchestration; not an external preservation validator.
classes.declared_host_dependency: A documented host dependency used by repository verification or extraction; availability must be explicit.
classes.external_independent_validator: An external analyzer or renderer whose output is corroborative or derived, never a primary promoted result.
classes.acquisition_only_runtime: A bounded external acquisition adapter that produces retained inputs, not a regeneration prerequisite.

entries.boundary: CLI archive fallback; native parsers and explicit failure states remain required.
Pinned noninteractive itch.io adapter; output is retained and independently measured before promotion.
Git delivery orchestration; not preservation evidence generation.
Chromium renders a derived demonstration; it is not a primary preservation result.
Git lists tracked authored text; no preservation claim is generated.
Pinned lybrown/dis runs only on a literal controlled MOS 6502 fixture; output is corroborative and not primary preservation evidence.
Second pinned lybrown/dis controlled-fixture run checks byte-identical output; it does not authorize retained-byte analysis.
Retained static-analysis output is derived and explicitly non-primary.
Verifier permits only repository-local Python regeneration commands.
